name: Cimmerian-Tombolo

civilization.name: Kethrim Ascendancy
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs dust seas stretching to the horizon, stark under a black sky.
The air carries ozone and crushed stone, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
